source='''def transform(grid):
    """Recover the zeroed rectangle from its reflection across the horizontal center."""
    height = len(grid)
    zero_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 0 in row]
    zero_cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(height))]
    return [[grid[height - 1 - r][c] for c in zero_cols] for r in zero_rows]
'''
